# Your account

## Who can have an account

Pantry accounts are created by whoever runs Pantry for your household. There's
no sign-up page: if you need an account for someone new, ask them.

## Signing in

Sign in with your email address and your password. If Pantry says **Wrong
email or password**, check both and try again.

## Forgotten your password

Pantry can't send password reset emails. Ask whoever runs Pantry for your
household to set a new password for you.

## Changing your name or email

Your name is what other people see on lists you share with them ("from Ann").
To change your name or the email you sign in with, ask whoever runs Pantry
for your household.

## Signing out

Press **Sign out** at the top of any page. Pantry may also sign everyone out
from time to time, for example after maintenance; just sign in again. Your
lists are kept.

## Your data

Your lists, items, and who you've shared them with are stored by the Pantry
your household runs. Deleting a list deletes it for everyone it was shared
with.
